scripts.dev:strict-3000: node -e "const { spawnSync, spawn } = require('child_process'); const port = 3000; const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const killPort = () => { if (isWin) { console.log('[dev:strict-3000] Windows detected; port-kill is not implemented here. Ensure 3000 is free.'); return; } const r = spawnSync('lsof', ['-nP', '-iTCP:' + port, '-sTCP:LISTEN', '-t'], { encoding: 'utf-8' }); const pids = (r.stdout || '').split(/\s+/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); if (!pids.length) return; console.log('[dev:strict-3000] Port ' + port + ' is in use by PID(s): ' + pids.join(', ') + '. Killing...'); for (const pid of pids) { try { process.kill(Number(pid), 'SIGTERM'); } catch {} } for (const pid of pids) { try { process.kill(Number(pid), 'SIGKILL'); } catch {} } }; killPort(); const cmd = isWin ? 'pnpm.cmd' : 'pnpm'; const child = spawn(cmd, ['exec', 'vite', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', String(port), '--strictPort'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); child.on('exit', (code) => process.exit(code ?? 1));"
scripts.dev:e2e: HOUYI_PORT=19000 HOUYI_UI_PORT=13100 VITE_WS_HOST=127.0.0.1:19000 pnpm exec vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 13100 --strictPort
scripts.e2e:install-browsers:proxy: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const env = { ...process.env }; if (!env.HTTPS_PROXY && !env.HTTP_PROXY && !env.ALL_PROXY && !isWin) { const r = spawnSync('scutil', ['--proxy'], { encoding: 'utf-8' }); const out = r.stdout || ''; const httpEnabled = /HTTPEnable\s*:\s*1/.test(out); const httpsEnabled = /HTTPSEnable\s*:\s*1/.test(out); const httpProxy = (out.match(/HTTPProxy\s*:\s*([^\n]+)/) || [])[1]?.trim(); const httpPort = (out.match(/HTTPPort\s*:\s*(\d+)/) || [])[1]?.trim(); const httpsProxy = (out.match(/HTTPSProxy\s*:\s*([^\n]+)/) || [])[1]?.trim(); const httpsPort = (out.match(/HTTPSPort\s*:\s*(\d+)/) || [])[1]?.trim(); if (httpEnabled && httpProxy && httpPort) env.HTTP_PROXY = `http://${httpProxy}:${httpPort}`; if (httpsEnabled && httpsProxy && httpsPort) env.HTTPS_PROXY = `http://${httpsProxy}:${httpsPort}`; } const cmd = isWin ? 'pnpm.cmd' : 'pnpm'; const r2 = spawnSync(cmd, ['exec', 'playwright', 'install', 'chromium'], { stdio: 'inherit', env }); process.exit(r2.status ?? 1);"
scripts.e2e:install-browsers:host: node -e "const host = process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_DOWNLOAD_HOST; if (!host) { console.error('Missing PLAYWRIGHT_DOWNLOAD_HOST. Set it in your shell, or use HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY for Playwright downloads.'); process.exit(1); } const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'pnpm.cmd' : 'pnpm'; const env = { ...process.env, PLAYWRIGHT_DOWNLOAD_HOST: host }; const r = spawnSync(cmd, ['exec','playwright','install','chromium'], { stdio: 'inherit', env }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.e2e:use-system-chrome: node -e "console.log('Using system Chrome for Playwright via HOUYI_USE_SYSTEM_CHROME=1');"
